adaptation: Pinned upstream JavaScript adapted to TypeScript using erased annotations, ambient declarations and overloads only. Two empty if statement bodies use equivalent empty blocks to satisfy TS1313. After erasing types, its normalized executable AST equals the original standalone vendor (executable_ast_sha256). Upstream package identity, license and original vendor digest remain unchanged. No parser behavior or external dependency loading is added.
purpose: Hash-bound TS/JS import AST extraction in the strict captured verification parent; never load a live node_modules parser.
